item.title: Digital transformation and AI-enabled accommodation platforms: Implications for destination marketing, governance and development
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines how digital transformation and artificial intelligence technologies integrated into accommodation platforms are reshaping destination marketing strategies, governance structures, and local development outcomes. The call invites research exploring the intersection of AI-enabled booking platforms with tourism destination management and community impacts.

Appel publié par Journal of Destination Marketing & Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
